activity.notes: Shō Hashi became king of Chūzan in 1422. ATLAS keeps this pre-unification phase separate from the Ryukyu Kingdom phase conventionally beginning with the 1429 unification of the Three Kingdoms.

sources.title: Ryukyu Chronology — Japan Tourism Agency
sources.citation_text: Japan's Tourism Agency chronology identifies Shō Hashi and the conventional 1429 unification of the Three Kingdoms that established the Ryukyu Kingdom.
